dict.string: papaSteps can add optional heart-rate, walking-asymmetry, step, and distance insights to completed walks.
papaSteps can save a completed outdoor walk and its route to Apple Health when you choose to enable that feature.
Precise location lets papaSteps record your route, route distance, speed, and direction of travel during a walk.
papaSteps uses your location during an active walk to record your route, speed, direction, and altitude.
papaSteps uses motion data to count steps, estimate walking distance, and measure elevation during a walk.
